verdict.rationale: Serving vision-language models is a fair question for an LLM inference engine, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions images, vision, or multimodal input. General claims of 200+ Hugging Face architectures and disaggregated 'encode' do not show that image-plus-text models are supported.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run vision-language models that understand images alongside text
